summary: A display without a declared rounding rule was only a warning even when it was no rounding of its source value (1.02 shown for 1.09).

observables: audit_claims findings for a display without a rounding rule (communication records)
impact.bias: a displayed number that is not a rounding of its source value (1.02 for 1.09) was a warning (occurrence.value_unrounded_comparison), not the value_mismatch error, so the audit could pass a wrong display
impact.trigger: an occurrence whose display value has no declared rounding rule and differs from the source value by more than a rounding

remedy: run audit_claims again with a release that has the fix; a new value_mismatch error names the display to correct
